'''Coruscant Daily Newsfeed''' was a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] news agency that reported on events dealing with the high society of Coruscant. It was known for its political correctness.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] it provided coverage of the events surrounding the kidnapping of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and its aftermath, including the couple's [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|wedding]], the opening of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaani]] exiles, and the appropriation of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] funds to resettle them.
